title: Jeff Pevar & Inger Nova share a song of awakening with "Green Light"
htmlContent: In our fast-paced world, Jeff Pevar and Inger Nova invite us to pause and connect with ourselves through their inspiring new single, "Green Light." This song is a heartfelt reminder to look beyond the chaos, fear, and distractions of everyday life to find our true selves. "Green Light" offers a rich listening experience that combines the warmth of folk-rock with deeper insights. The song tells a story about a man who feels safe but trapped in his illusions. He learns to embrace something more authentic and free, and you can feel that moment of change in every beat. Pevar and Nova have been collaborating for over 20 years, and their chemistry shines in this song. Their voices blend beautifully; sometimes, they take turns singing lines and other times, they harmonize together, creating a sound that feels genuine and engaging. This is something you truly feel. Jeff Pevar, who has worked with famous artists like Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young, plays all the instruments on the track, except for the strong drums and percussion played by Steve DiStanislao, who has also worked with well-known musicians. The combination results in a rich sound that feels both big and personal. https://soundcloud.com/jeffpevarmusic/green-light Inger Nova Jorgensen, who wrote most of the lyrics and created the melody during a quiet moment on the beautiful north shore of Kaua'i, brings her talent to the forefront. Her words are straightforward yet artistic, inviting listeners to reflect that the light is green. Produced by Pevar himself, "Green Light" is like a personal awakening wrapped in beautiful melodies. Whether you're facing new challenges or standing at a crossroads in life, this song encourages you to move forward with courage and purpose.
excerpt: Jeff Pevar and Inger Nova collaborate on "Green Light," a soulful song symbolizing awakening and new beginnings, inviting listeners to embrace hope and renewal.
